newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGAL POST OFFICE SEES RECORD PROFIT IN '97.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGAL POST OFFICE SEES RECORD PROFIT IN '97.

text.p: The Portuguese post office CTT - Correios de Portugal expects to obtain record profits for 1997 after posting a 47.5 percent increase in first-half profits to 1.192 billion escudos, a statement said.

"This value (six-month profit) was achieved despite an extraordinary contribution of 4.5 billion escudos to the pension fund, which leads the board led by Norberto Pilar to expect the best results since 1993, when the company was disconnected from telecommunications activities," it said.
CTT posted a net profit of 808 million escudos in the first half of 1996.
